_comment_distance_threshold: Fixed 2026-10: distance_threshold is now per-dataset (moved out of defaults), set so both datasets use roughly the same physical neighbourhood (~14.28um), not the same pixel count. IMMUcan: 14.28px at the project's long-standing ~1um/px assumption (never independently confirmed -- see HANDOFF). cHL: 31.73px = 14.28um / 0.45um/px, where 0.45um/px is Julia's figure (not independently verifiable from this dataset's files -- no PhysicalSize in the OME-XML, no real TIFF resolution tag, only a placeholder XResolution=(1,1)). The segmentation folder name's 'mpp1.75' was considered and NOT used here -- it most likely describes a segmentation-model target resolution, not the raw acquisition mpp, but this was never independently confirmed either.

chl._comment_excluded_markers: Must match the exact filenames under single_channel_dir / lines in markers.txt -- 'anti-H2AX' alone (no suffix) silently fails to match 'anti-H2AX (pS139)' and would NOT be excluded. Fixed 2026-09-23.
chl._comment_excluded_labels: Per Lukas 2026-10: 'undefined' is kept as a real, scored class on cHL for every method -- other supervised methods in the benchmark predict and are scored on it too, so dropping it here would be inconsistent.
